description: This file defines the LoanArrearsAgingService interface which declares methods related to loan arrears aging calculations, schedule updates, and data retrieval within the Fineract loan portfolio module.

classes.name: LoanArrearsAgingService
classes.description: Interface for services handling loan arrears aging processes, updates, and calculations.

methods.name: updateLoanArrearsAgeingDetailsWithOriginalSchedule
methods.description: Updates the loan arrears aging details based on the original schedule.

methods.name: getScheduleDate
methods.description: Retrieves the schedule date data mapped by loan ID.

methods.name: createInsertStatements
methods.description: Creates SQL insert statements based on schedule data and a flag indicating the type of statement.

methods.name: updateScheduleWithPaidDetail
methods.description: Updates the schedule with paid details for loans.

methods.name: calculateArrearsForLoan
methods.description: Calculates arrears data for a specific loan.
